name: io.github.codeonthetable/gecici-email
title: gecici.email - Disposable Email & OTP Extraction
description: Autonomous disposable email inbox, smart OTP/verification code extraction, and activation link parser for Claude, Claude Code, and AI Agents.

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Generate a new disposable email address instantly on gecici.email with custom or random prefix.

prefix.description: Optional custom mailbox prefix (e.g. 'claude-test-99'). Defaults to random secure ID.

tools.name: wait_for_otp
tools.description: Wait and automatically extract a 4-8 digit OTP verification code (e.g., 554901) from incoming emails.

address.description: The email address to listen on (e.g., 'bahadir@gecici.email').

tools.name: wait_for_link
tools.description: Wait and automatically extract activation, confirmation, or password reset links from incoming emails.

address.description: The email address to listen on.

pattern.description: Optional keyword or regex to match specific URLs (e.g. 'verify', 'confirm').

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: List all received emails for a specific inbox with metadata and subject.

tools.name: get_message_content
tools.description: Get full text body, HTML content, headers, and parsed codes for a specific message.
